summary: Test suite has critical gaps that violate the task's core requirement. Task explicitly mandates 'ALL tests must run through act' and requires a harness that (1) sets up temp repos with fixture data, (2) executes `act push --rm` for each test case, (3) captures output to `act-result.txt`, and (4) asserts exact values. The provided tests split into local unit tests (validator.test.ts, cli.test.ts, report.test.ts) that bypass act entirely, and act-result.test.ts that passively parses a pre-existing artifact without any mechanism to generate it. Missing: the test orchestration harness, fixture files (fixtures/mixed.json, fixtures/all-ok.json), the workflow file itself (.github/workflows/secret-rotation-validator.yml), and any invocation of `act push`. Unit tests do cover reasonable edge cases locally (date parsing, boundary classifications, error messages), but this doesn't satisfy the requirement that 'every single test case must execute through the GitHub Actions workflow via act.' The disconnect between test design (local unit tests) and task requirement (all tests via act) is fundamental and unfixable without a complete rewrite. Would not catch regressions in the actual CI/CD pipeline since it's never validated there.
